answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. The design leans on bonding curves for dynamic participation pricing. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The timber holds work receipts rather than names, so the sparrow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
